readings.moment: Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen
when the hall clock struck eleven
the temple struck eleven (Fräulein Lina stayed in the kitchen until after this)

durations: Fräulein Lina stayed in the kitchen with Rosa from 10:37 (kitchen clock) until after the temple struck eleven
Madame's piano played from 10:48 until 11:01 by the kitchen clock, thirteen minutes
whereabouts: Rosa was in the kitchen at the back of the house earlier in the evening, preparing the glasses and the champagne
Fräulein Lina came down into the kitchen at 10:37 (kitchen clock) and stayed with Rosa until after the temple struck eleven
Madame was playing the piano (Chopin) from 10:48 to 11:01 (kitchen clock), as heard by Rosa in the kitchen
Rosa went up the stairs to the atelier to fetch the master for the toast
Rosa opened the door of the atelier and found the master on the floor
The master was lying in the atelier upstairs, on the floor, with his repeater in his hand
At the time of the interview, Rosa was sitting in the dining room with the police
